thread:
viv: Hi team — quick issue. I uploaded my passport to the kiosk but it rejected with 'file too large' even though it's 4MB. My start is next Wed in Brazil. Also payroll asked for CPF and I don't have it yet.

omar: Hey Viv — for uploads try saving as pdf or compressing jpeg. If mobile, take photo in landscape and don't use HEIC. If still blocked, email docs to onboarding@redwood.example and ppl-ops will upload.

lina: For CPF, payroll can proceed with provisional withholding; ask Viv to get CPF within 30 days. Lina -> I'll loop finance.

hrbot: intl-payroll: Brazil -> Require CPF for local payroll. If missing, payroll applies statutory withholding until CPF provided. USD payout needs FX setup.

viv: I resent via onboarding email. Subject: UPLOAD: VIV_PASSPORT. Also happy to do remote notary if needed.

onboard-bot: file-received: onboarding@redwood.example -> viv_passport.jpg (3.9MB).

itbot: Attempting portal upload... portal returned error: "image dimensions exceed max". Suggest sanitizing: `magick viv_passport.jpg -resize 2000x2000 -quality 85 viv_sanitized.pdf` or send smaller jpg.

lina: I'll sanitize and upload on your behalf, Viv. Also creating provisional start note so you can still begin next Wed pending CPF and final payroll.

onboard-bot: action-created: provisional-start-2712345678 -> "Viv provisional start allowed; access non-prod only until CPF & payroll cleared."

security: Scoped access OK (no prod). Create infra ticket for temp creds.

itbot: Created infra ticket onboard-temp-2712345678. Laptop shipping confirmed. Viv, confirm shipping address in profile.

viv: Address confirmed. Thanks everyone. One question: am I eligible for benefits right away or after payroll setup?

lina: Benefits: enrollment opens week 1 but final eligibility needs payroll enrollment (CPF). We'll give you benefits orientation and provisional enrollment; final enrollment completed when payroll confirms CPF. Link: https://benefits.redwood.example/newhire

omar: If upload fails again, we'll schedule TrustID remote notarization and cover the cost (preapproved up to $60 for BR). Also please upload a selfie holding passport for BG vendor.

onboard-bot: bg-check: vendor-email-sent -> awaiting selfie.

lina: Summary: sanitized upload succeeded and was accepted; provisional non-prod access approved; payroll notified to allow provisional withholding until CPF provided; benefits orientation scheduled week 1. We'll post update when payroll confirms.

oviv: Thanks all! Looking forward to day 1 44b
